candidates.name: Emberwake
candidates.host: One two-handed melee weapon; replaces one compatible weapon-enchant channel, subject to a future route qualification.
candidates.wearer_gate: The exact finished two-handed weapon must be equipped. Four qualifying owner weapon hits must land on the same hostile target; the effect is item-local.

artisan_gate.requirements: The artisan must have naturally trained Enchanting 375 and character level 70, know this exact custom design entitlement, and work at an approved city enchanting station. Native profession rank, character level, reagent, slot, and recipe checks remain authoritative; this design grants no skill, rank, or XP.

unlock.exact_recipe_entitlement: A per-character entitlement to this design only. It is created only when the recipient learns the matching custom pattern folio; it is not granted by possessing the craft relic, by guild membership, or by a boss legacy attribute reward.

blueprint.name: Ragnaros Emberwake Pattern Folio
blueprint.acquisition: Proposed transferable encounter reward after verified eligible participation in Molten Core — Ragnaros; no existing item or drop is assumed.

unlock.relic_separation: Ragnaros Ember Relic is a distinct transferable encounter-earned craft input, consumed once for each finished commission. It does not unlock the recipe and does not refresh charges.
unlock.encounter_award: Both pattern folio and craft relic are proposed unimplemented encounter rewards. Award only from verified actual encounter participation and victory; never infer from a boss name, corpse, add, probe, or historical gear.

mechanic.trigger: While in combat, the wearer lands four direct melee weapon hits on the same hostile target within 10 seconds. The fourth hit spends one charge and arms an 8-second Emberwake window.
mechanic.effect: Persistent passive: +15 Fire resistance points on this item. Charged signature: The next direct melee special on that same target during the window adds Fire damage equal to 15% of that strike's pre-critical, unmodified weapon damage. The bonus is one direct hit and cannot crit or trigger another enchant.
mechanic.icd_rule: Cooldown begins when a charge is spent and remains attached to this item through relog and equipment changes.
mechanic.empty_behavior: At zero charges, the persistent passive remains and the signature is inert. A recharge batch is accepted only when at least five charges are missing; it restores exactly five. No charge is granted by relog, equip swap, death, trade, or a boss legacy award.

reusable_tools: City-owned enchanting rod and workbench fixtures
Reusable elemental containment crucible matched to this pattern
Reusable signature-alignment frame
Reusable inspection mirror and calibration weights

recharge.notes: Requires at least five missing charges. Consumes the complete ordinary-material bill and restores exactly five, without overfilling. No boss kill, relic/core, blueprint, or encounter token is used. Recharging is an active city workshop order; it cannot progress offline.

stages.name: Elemental temper

teaching.progression: Teaching grants no native profession skill, profession rank, character level, XP, boss legacy reward, or combat attribute.

unlock.relic_separation: Hakkar Blood Relic is a distinct transferable encounter-earned craft input, consumed once for each finished commission. It does not unlock the recipe and does not refresh charges.

mechanic.trigger: When a direct melee special lands on a hostile target, the wearer may spend 2% of maximum health to empower the hit, but only if paying that cost leaves the wearer at or above 30% maximum health. Otherwise the charge and health are untouched.
